name: Airhead Viper 3-Person Towable Tube, Red
description: Grab your family and friends for a fun day out on the water in the Airhead® Viper 3-Person Towable Tube! The bottom is shaped like a boat hull to provide a lively yet secure ride. The Viper is designed for comfort, featuring inflated floors and nylon wrap handles with neoprene knuckle guards. The cockpits provide a feeling of security while riding, making the Viper an excellent choice for younger riders. FEATURES: 3 Riders Cockpit-style 6 handles Bottom of the towable is shaped like a boat hull for a lively yet stable ride Cockpits feature comfortable inflated floors Striped nylon wrap handles feature neoprene knuckle guards for comfort Made of durable 30 gauge PVC Covered in durable double-stitched nylon with no exposed PVC Boston valve is covered by an EVA cap Dimensions: 93" x 67" Model #: AHVI-F3 Size: One Size. Color: Red. Gender: Unisex.

name: Sevylor K1 Quipak 1 Person Inflatable Kayak, Blue
description: Hit the water in as little as five minutes with the Sevylor K1 Quikpak 1-person inflatable kayak, where getting to your next trek is as easy as backpack, unpack, kayak. The innovative backpack system carries everything you need to get going and ultimately folds out into your kayak's seat. The 21-gauge PVC construction of the Sevylor inflatable kayak and rugged tarpaulin bottom easily handle the rigors of the lake. Just in case you do hit a snag, the multiple air chambers will help you get back to shore. The back rest and multi-position foot rest make exploring the waterways more comfortable. The drink holder and bungee storage area of the Sevylor K1 Quikpak 1-person inflatable kayak keep your drink and gear easily accessible. Size: 1. Color: Blue. Gender: Male.

name: Wow Sports Zig Zag 2-Person Towable Tube
description: Wow Sports Zig Zag 2-Person Towable Tube. Tired of riding boat tubes where you just hang on and are at the mercy of the boat driver Well, the Zig Zag, an original concept from WOW, puts you in control of your ride. WOW has developed a new, patented, Flex-Wing system that allows the rider to easily steer back and forth over the wake, turn on a dime, jump the wake, and even do barrel rolls while the boat driver simply goes straight! No fragile fins or fancy tow point is necessary to fly from way outside one wake to way outside the other. Because of the new construction the wings act as a rudder that drives into the water to steer you in the direction you want to go. And it is EZ to do, simply jump from one wing to the other. The rider can lay, sit, kneel, STAND, and do barrel rolls. It can be used as a regular towable tube for boating as well. You were Born to Ride with the new Zig Zag from WOW.Features: 1-2 Riders Patented Flex-Wing system allows for easy steering No fragile fins or fancy tow points necessary Lay, sit, kneel, stand, and do barrel rolls 100% Heavy Duty PVC Construction Double Webbing Foam Handles with Knuckle Guards EVA Foam Pads Speed Valve for Fast Inflation and Deflation Dimensions Inflated 60 x 54 inch
